question: Where must the supporting feet be placed in relation to the sub-base?
premises: Supporting feet are required at that location.
The sub-base end defines the position.
inference: The feet should be placed at the end of the sub-base.
uncertainties: The fused form vidheyāssyuḥ reflects sandhi in the given token.
